reason: Intentional: the product sells calm, anti-noise job search. A persistent nav contradicts the brand; only a lone 'Sign in' chip sits in the hero, plus a visible skip link.

This is a client-rendered React SPA (no JS = no page at all, so progressive-enhancement concerns are moot). Content lives in the DOM; reveals are IntersectionObserver class toggles per the existing design system.

The design system deliberately defines four consistent control families (primary with hard shadow, ghost text link, small chip, checkbox toggle), all sharing the same flat neo-brutalist language, border and shadow tokens.
DESIGN.md defines a three-role type scale (display / section heading / eyebrow). The checker sees two close clamps; they are distinct roles in the documented scale.

The 'empty' region is the scroll-length spacer that drives the sticky card stack; content is full opacity and readable while its card is active during real scrolling. The checker samples the static full-page capture.
